I am C-3PO, Human-Cyborg Relations for Star Tours Spacelines, the preeminent spaceline in the galaxy!|C-3PO|<ref name="DL site">{{Disney|subdomain=disneyland|domain=go.com|url=disneyland/en_US/parks/attractions/detail?name=StarToursAttractionPage|text=Disneyland: Star Tours|nolive=1}}</ref>}}
'''Star Tours''', also known as '''Star Tours Travel Agency'''<ref name="TCSWE">''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''</ref> and '''Star Tours Spacelines''', was an interstellar travel agency which gave tours to prominent [[Planet/Legends|planets]] and [[Moon/Legends|moons]] in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. The company existed as far back as the time of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], but was forced to file for bankruptcy in the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], after a series of dramatic accidents.

==History==
{{Quote|The Star Tours Getaway Package is three times the fun in one. So ask your travel consultant to book yours today!|A Star Tours commercial|<ref name="COM">{{SWArchive|url=fans/events/celebration_v_startourspromo/index.html|text=New Star Tours "Commercial"}}</ref>}}
[[File:C3PO_Star_Tours.jpg|thumb|left|C-3PO in the spaceport hangar]]
The Star Tours travel agency existed around the time of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]],<ref name="Billboard" /> a pan-[[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] conflict that broke out in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> At the time, the company notably organized tours to [[Glee Anselm/Legends|Glee Anselm]],<ref name="Billboard" /> a [[Water/Legends|water]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] with tropical climate.<ref name="TCWCG">''[[The Clone Wars Campaign Guide]]''</ref> However, the starline greatly expanded its business at some point between [[1 BBY/Legends|1]] and [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]]<ref name="ST2 date">According to [[Star Wars Insider 127|''Star Wars Insider'' 127]] [[Star Tours: The Adventures Continue]]'' takes place between [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'']] and [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']]. In the attraction's queue, the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[G2-9T/Legends|G2-9T]] refers to the secret base of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]], the [[Great Temple/Legends|Great Temple]] on [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]]. According to [[Star Wars: Underworld: The Yavin Vassilika|''Underworld: The Yavin Vassilika'']], the Rebels only acquired the key to the Great Temple in [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]]. The attraction must therefore take place after that.</ref> under new management<ref name="Convenient Daily Departures">{{SW|url=news/convenient-daily-departures-the-history-of-star-tours|text=Convenient Daily Departures: The History of ''Star Tours''|int=Convenient Daily Departures: The History of Star Tours|nolive=1}}</ref>, opening a new intergalactic space terminal on a [[Spaceport THX1138|space station]] in the [[Earth system]], which it shared with fellow member companies of the [[Galactic Tourist Bureau/Legends|Galactic Tourist Bureau]]. The agency hoped to promote unrestricted travel through the galaxy despite the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire's]] oppression. [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaanian]] [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Raymus Antilles/Legends|Raymus Antilles]] assisted in the launch of the expanded spaceline by assigning [[Droid/Legends|droids]] [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] and [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] to help launch their new spaceport.<ref name="ST2 Crawl">''[[Star Tours: The Adventures Continue]]'' opening crawl shown at the [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=sUlwM0QH5go Florida Grand Opening].</ref>

Flights had a non-smoking policy, which, according to droid [[G2-9T/Legends|G2-9T]], also extended to luggage. In addition, there was a policy against smuggling droids in the luggage, although G2-9T often turned a blind eye. Animals were also barred from entering flights, requiring that any animals found in luggage be placed in quarantine. Passengers were required to wear [[flight glasses]] during trips.<ref name="ST2" /> In addition, passengers were sometimes required to bring with them [[Imperial authorization form]]s to access certain destinations, such as [[Bothan Space/Legends|Bothan Space]], and were also forbidden from accepting packages from unidentified individuals.<ref name="Tokyo">Mentioned in the queue-area video for the Disneyland Tokyo version of ''[[Star Tours: The Adventures Continue]]''</ref>

On an early voyage, prior to the ship's departure from the terminal, a maintenance mishap during the last minute led the protocol droid C-3PO inadvertently replaced [[AC-38/Legends|AC-38]] as the pilot via getting trapped by the autopilot in the cockpit of the ship before it was elevated to the loading area where the passengers (including a [[Unidentified Rebel spy|Rebel spy]]) board. But before the ship (with C-3PO in it) can leave the spaceport, Imperial agents discovered the presence of the Rebel spy on board and attempted to arrest the Rebel. The vessel took off and fought its way past Imperial ships surrounding the space station, crippling an [[Imperial I-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial I''-class Star Destroyer]] in the process. After being chased through [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]], the [[StarSpeeder 1000]] landed and delivered the spy to safety. 

At the time of the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Star Tours' space cruiser ''[[Tzarina]]'' was involved in a tragic accident that cost most of its passengers their lives. For unknown reasons the ship's droid captain decided to change course towards [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin]] to show his passengers "something neat." Once there, the yacht collided with an unidentified [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE fighter]] variant that was tumbling out of control through space. The collision caused the ''Tzarina''{{'s}} [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]] to initiate and throw the ship into [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]]. When it fell out of hyperspace half a galaxy away, it crash-landed on [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]] in the [[Quelii sector/Legends|Quelii sector]]. Only [[Unidentified Tzarina survivor|one passenger]] was known to survive the crash and find his way to the Dathomir [[Trade Outpost]], where he told others his story.<ref name="Star Wars Galaxies">{{GalaxiesAED}}</ref>

Immediately following the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], Star Tours sought to capitalize on the [[Moddell sector/Legends|Moddell sector's]] sudden fame by promising "convenient [[Endor Express|daily departures]] to the exotic moon of [[Endor/Legends|Endor]]" along the decaying [[Sanctuary Pipeline/Legends|Sanctuary Pipeline]].<ref name="Star Wars Gamer 9" /> During this time, C-3PO and R2-D2 again briefly worked for the agency, having been placed on temporary loan by the agency while their owners in the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] were fighting against the [[Tof/Legends|Tofs]] during the [[Nagai–Tof War|Nagai-Tof invasion]].<ref name="Convenient Daily Departures" /> One pilot for this flight, [[RX-24/Legends|RX-24]], failed to actually make it to the Endor moon and instead sped quickly out of the system and into a battle between the New Republic and remnants of the Galactic Empire along with the [[Death Star III|third Death Star]].<ref name="ST" />

Several months later, after a variety of accidents and mismanagement, the company was driven out of business.<ref name="Star Wars Gamer 9" />

==Fleet==
[[File:StarToursGamer9.jpg|thumb|300px|A StarSpeeder 3000 on Endor]]

Star Tours's fleet was once dominated by the 40-passenger StarSpeeder 1000 piloted by [[AC series pilot droid]]s, but in later years, the carrier used a next-generation fleet of [[StarSpeeder 3000]] vehicles, such as [[Transport 22]]. These vessels were piloted by questionably competent [[RX-series pilot droid/Legends|RX-Series pilot droids]] and carried an astromech unit. Despite the agency's claim that the ships were highly advanced, they were often in need of repair.

Star Tours used other ships besides the StarSpeeder. The ill-fated ''[[Tzarina]]'' was a Corellian vessel similar to a [[CR70 corvette/Legends|CR70]] or [[CR90 corvette/Legends|CR90 corvette]].

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:StarSpeeder1000_Coruscant.png|thumb|250px|A StarSpeeder 1000 in the skies of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]]]
[[Star Tours (real-world)|''Star Tours'']] is a theme-park attraction located at Tomorrowland in [[Disneyland]], as well as at three other [[The Walt Disney Company|Disney]] theme parks, including the filmmaking-oriented [[Disney's Hollywood Studios]] at [[Wikipedia:Walt Disney World|Walt Disney World]].

Originally opened at Disneyland in [[1987]] with a single flight, the Endor Express, ''Star Tours'' has since been [[Star Tours: The Adventures Continue|re-imagined]] so that as many as 54 different experiences are available to passengers. Destinations now include Coruscant, Naboo, Tatooine, Hoth, Kashyyyk, Geonosis, and the first Death Star.

References to Star Tours have appeared in various [[Star Wars Legends|Expanded Universe]] sources, and a number of action figures based on the attraction's droids, particularly RX-24 ("Rex"), have been released.

The [[canon]]icity of the events depicted in the original ''Star Tours'' experience has been disputed for many reasons, the most obvious being the inclusion of the [[Death Star/Legends|Death Star]]. R2-D2's presence aboard the StarSpeeder 3000 precludes the events taking place during the Battle of Yavin or the Battle of Endor, and the Death Star seen in the ride does not have the skeletal appearance of the [[Death Star prototype]] constructed at [[Maw Cluster/Legends|The Maw]]; additionally, Endor is far from The Maw, and R2-D2 is accounted for during the major battle over the prototype, as well. This may have indicated it was an unrevealed Death Star or, as some suggested, a modified [[habitation sphere]]. [[Leland Chee]] tentatively named it [[Death Star III]], and it was later confirmed canon within Legends in the [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars Blog|blog]] post [[Convenient Daily Departures: The History of Star Tours]]. This post also placed the event in question during the [[Nagai–Tof War]] to explain C-3PO and R2-D2's presence in the ride.

In [[Star Wars: TIE Fighter (video game)|''Star Wars: TIE Fighter'']], a [[Lambda-class T-4a shuttle/Legends|''Lambda''-class T-4a shuttle]] called [[StarTour 7|''Startour 7'']] can be inspected by the player during one of the TIE Interceptor training missions, although it is unclear whether it had any actual affiliation with the company besides name and it carrying tourists.

In the [[Tokyo Disneyland]] version of the ride, additional planets/astro locations were added in as visitable locales: specifically, the desert world of [[Bar Neth]], the water world of [[Praya]], and [[the Edge of the Galaxy]].<ref name="STJPN" /> These locations as well as the footage were in fact reused from the three endings for the defunct [[Wikipedia:Epcot|Epcot]] ride [[Wikipedia:Horizons (Epcot)|Horizons]], regarding the Mesa Verde, Sea Castle, and Space Colony Brava Centauri, respectively. The endings and scenarios from that ride dealt with the concepts of arid-zone agriculture, ocean colonization, and space colonization, respectively.

The Star Tours Travel Agency has been compared to real-life airlines, including how they operate in loading passengers onto flights.
